description: This file defines plugin hook constants, interface, and method signatures for Mattermost plugins, enabling event handling such as user actions, message processing, file uploads, WebSocket events, and integrations like SAML login.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Interface defining plugin hook methods for handling various events in Mattermost.

methods.name: OnActivate
methods.description: Invoked when the plugin is activated; returns error if activation fails.

methods.name: Implemented
methods.description: Returns a list of hooks implemented by the plugin.

methods.name: OnDeactivate
methods.description: Invoked when the plugin is deactivated; last chance to use the API.

methods.name: OnConfigurationChange
methods.description: Called when configuration may have changed.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests routed to the plugin.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes registered commands.

methods.name: UserHasBeenCreated
methods.description: Called after a user is created.

methods.name: UserWillLogIn
methods.description: Called before user login; returning non-empty string rejects login.

methods.name: UserHasLoggedIn
methods.description: Called after user login.

methods.name: MessageWillBePosted
methods.description: Invoked before a message is posted; can modify, reject, or dismiss the post.

methods.name: MessageWillBeUpdated
methods.description: Invoked before a message update.

methods.name: MessageHasBeenPosted
methods.description: Called after a message has been posted.

methods.name: MessageHasBeenUpdated
methods.description: Called after a message has been updated.

methods.name: MessagesWillBeConsumed
methods.description: Invoked before messages are returned to client.

methods.name: MessageHasBeenDeleted
methods.description: Called after a message is deleted.

methods.name: ChannelHasBeenCreated
methods.description: Invoked after channel creation.

methods.name: UserHasJoinedChannel
methods.description: Called after user joins a channel.

methods.name: UserHasLeftChannel
methods.description: Called after user leaves a channel.

methods.name: UserHasJoinedTeam
methods.description: Called after user joins a team.

methods.name: UserHasLeftTeam
methods.description: Called after user leaves a team.

methods.name: FileWillBeUploaded
methods.description: Before a file upload is committed; can reject or modify the file.

methods.name: FileWillBeDownloaded
methods.description: Before a file download is sent; can reject.

methods.name: ReactionHasBeenAdded
methods.description: After a reaction is added.

methods.name: ReactionHasBeenRemoved
methods.description: After a reaction is removed.

methods.name: OnPluginClusterEvent
methods.description: Handles intra-cluster plugin events.

methods.name: OnWebSocketConnect
methods.description: When a websocket connection opens.

methods.name: OnWebSocketDisconnect
methods.description: When a websocket connection closes.

methods.name: WebSocketMessageHasBeenPosted
methods.description: When a websocket message is received.

methods.name: RunDataRetention
methods.description: During data retention jobs.

methods.name: OnInstall
methods.description: After plugin installation.

methods.name: OnSendDailyTelemetry
methods.description: When server sends telemetry data.

methods.name: OnCloudLimitsUpdated
methods.description: When product limits change.

methods.name: ConfigurationWillBeSaved
methods.description: Before saving configuration.

methods.name: EmailNotificationWillBeSent
methods.description: Before an email notification is sent.

methods.name: NotificationWillBePushed
methods.description: Before a push notification is sent.

methods.name: UserHasBeenDeactivated
methods.description: When a user is deactivated.

methods.name: ServeMetrics
methods.description: Expose plugin metrics endpoint.

methods.name: OnSharedChannelsSyncMsg
methods.description: Receive shared channel sync messages.

methods.name: OnSharedChannelsPing
methods.description: Indicate plugin and connection health.

methods.name: PreferencesHaveChanged
methods.description: After user preferences change.

methods.name: OnSharedChannelsAttachmentSyncMsg
methods.description: Receive shared channel attachment sync messages.

methods.name: OnSharedChannelsProfileImageSyncMsg
methods.description: Receive shared channel profile image sync messages.

methods.name: GenerateSupportData
methods.description: Include plugin content in support packets.

methods.name: OnSAMLLogin
methods.description: After successful SAML login.
